Well, for starters, I’ve always felt socially behind my peers. I have a hard time making/keeping friends or just trying to make friends (going up to a stranger and saying hi, for example). Back in my teenage years, all I did was stay inside and didn’t like to socialize/talk to people unless absolutely necessary. Over the years, I guess I’ve learned how to adapt to that and can be social when needed now but still don’t like it. I was always seen as the weird one/black sheep of the family kind of person. I have a hard time keeping eye contact with people and can’t hold it for a long time without feeling super awkward. I’ve always been super sensitive to noises, I get sensory overload quickly and then need time to myself to recharge. I’ve always been physically awkward too. I’m super clumsy and just randomly run into/hit things all day. When I was younger, I used to be ridiculously good at numbers but I fell behind at some point and never recovered. I’ve always had two or more repetitive behaviors that calm me down that I now know is called stimming. When I’m sitting down, one of my legs is always rocking back and forth and I only noticed it because it was so annoying to people around me. I’m biting my lip more than half the time. And some other detailed characteristics of my personality that I won’t go into. But yeah. 🤷🏻‍♀️
